findings.subject: AGENTS.md rules
findings.summary: 7 of the 15 AGENTS.md rules give neither a check nor why there is none, and nothing tests that they must.
findings.evidence: packages/cli/src/rules.mjs:9 query-first, :14 compose-before-create, :19 contract-values, :35 quiet-secondary-actions, :40 one-boundary, :45 on-media-colors, :80 as-child-spreads-props have no `check` and their `why` does not address enforcement. agents-md.test.mjs and core.test.mjs:686 only require a reason; no test validates `check` ids against craft-rules.mjs.
findings.fix: Add an `enforcement` field to every rule: the check id (contract-values -> tsc unions; multiple-primary -> vibe-measure; as-child -> a story/test; one-boundary/on-media -> a craft rule if feasible) or a one-line 'not checkable because ...'. Render it in the AGENTS block and add a test that every rule has one and every named craft id exists in craft-rules.mjs.

verified.reason: Reproduced from the source. packages/cli/src/rules.mjs has 15 rules. 6 carry `check` (tokens-only, content-colors, logical-directions, focus-visible, focus-ring-outline, theme-agnostic). accent-sparingly (vibe measures) and accessible-by-default (axe in CI) say how they are enforced in `why`. The other 7 (query-first, compose-before-create, contract-values, quiet-secondary-actions, one-boundary, on-media-colors, as-child-spreads-props) give no check and no reason why there is none. check:agents-md is `sync-agents-md.mjs --check`, a sync check only. agents-md.test.mjs:9-13 and core.test.mjs ('lists the rules, each with a reason') only require `why`. Nothing checks `check` ids against scripts/design-system/lib/craft-rules.mjs. So U2 is not met as written. Downgraded because the rules are still delivered and work, and no consumer runs into this. The fix is a one-line 'why no check' per rule plus a test. That fits score 2 ('works, with a known gap'), not 1.

findings.evidence: .: `git status` shows case-studies-round-12.md and case-studies-round-13a.md as untracked; absent from .. 13a ran on 889ecc81 (case-studies-round-13a.md:7), 14 of 48 web arms, 3 judge runs vs the 5-run default (case-studies-round-12.md:175), system-share left out (13a:12-14), doc-page -4 untraced (13a:24).
findings.fix: Commit the Round 12/13a reports; rerun the web arms (all 48, 5-run judge) on current main and add a per-failure layer column (tokens / components / templates / CLI / harness) to the report.

verified.reason: Partly holds. Confirmed: the case-studies-round-12.md and round-13a.md files and the other case-study docs are untracked in . (`git status` shows `??`), and `git ls-files` in ds-review lists none. `git log 889ecc81..HEAD` gives 19 commits with no rerun after them, and 13a:12-14 says system-share was left out. Overstated: 'Round 13' is the harness round itself, 13a/13b, named in proposal-ds-full-review.md:20, so the baseline exists but is not committed. 3 judge runs was deliberate, to compare with Round 12 (13a:7-9). The 'doc-page -4 untraced' point is refuted by the repo's own noise rule (case-studies-round-12.md:175: treat a single case moving by less than about 7 points as noise). The available outcome data does not regress: mobile web +9.0, desktop +0.6. What is left is a missing fresh measurement and uncommitted docs. That is a process step in the review plan, not a defect in the system, so P2.

findings.subject: packages/cli
findings.summary: A misspelled token name returns unrelated tokens with exit 0 instead of not-found with a nearest-name suggestion.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 token --a63-text-primay --json` -> type token.results, first result --a63-action-control-text-shadow; --a63-text-primary not listed. core.mjs:546-556 falls back to word search for any dashed name. AGENTS rule 4 tells agents to look names up with this command.
findings.fix: When the query is a full --a63-* name with no exact match, return token.not_found with edit-distance suggestions (as component.not_found does for 'dropdown').

findings.subject: Docs coverage
findings.summary: 223 of 778 public export names (outside ui-foundation) appear in no agent-readable docs, and the check only maps entry points to pages.
findings.evidence: Script over packages/cli/generated/agent-index.json docs+component Markdown: @atom63/ui-react/media/lightbox 27/28 missing, @atom63/inform/surfaces 13/14 (InformBanner...), @atom63/ui-react/theme 21/26, @atom63/widgets 27/35 (incl. `cn`), @atom63/mdx/primitives 24/28. `atom63 docs pattern-inform` never names InformBanner: JSX inside <ExampleContainer> (apps/docs/src/pages/pattern-inform.mdx:139-150) is dropped from the twin. build-index.mjs:160-170 checks the page mapping only.
findings.fix: Emit example JSX into the Markdown twins; extend check:agent-index to fail on an export no page names (with an explicit allowlist for internal constants), and drop leaked internals such as widgets `cn` from the public surface.
